Klasse Tuple2<A1,A2>

java.lang.Object
org.quurz.foomp.base.util.Tuple2<A1,A2>
Typparameter:
A1 - type of the first value
A2 - type of the second value
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
Supplier<A1>, Appliable2<Tuple2.µ,A1,A2>, Copyable<Tuple2<A1,A2>>, Mappable2<Tuple2.µ,A1,A2>, Swappable<Tuple2<A2,A1>, A1, A2>, Unwindable<Tuple2<A1,A2>>, Value<A1>, Value2<A1,A2>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher2<Tuple2.µ,A1,A2>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Hkt<Tuple2.µ>
public final class Tuple2<A1,A2> extends Object implements Mappable2<Tuple2.µ,A1,A2>, Appliable2<Tuple2.µ,A1,A2>, Swappable<Tuple2<A2,A1>, A1, A2>, Copyable<Tuple2<A1,A2>>, Unwindable<Tuple2<A1,A2>>, Value2<A1,A2>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher2<Tuple2.µ,A1,A2>

An immutable, lazy 2‑tuple that holds two non‑null values (A1, A2). Both components are stored via Supplier to allow lazy retrieval, i.e., values are evaluated only when accessed.

Semantics:

  • Lazy access: values are retrieved on demand using suppliers (see get1()/get2()).
  • Mapping: map/map1/map2/mapAll transform components eagerly at call site.
  • Applicative: applyTo applies functions carried by another Tuple2 to the respective values.
  • Structure: swap, with1/with2, copy, toRecord provide structural utilities.

Contract: unless stated otherwise, inputs must not be null and results must not be null. Methods enforce null‑checks to provide predictable behavior with lazy values.

Examples: 

  var t = Tuple2.tuple2(21, "x");
  t.get1();                    // 21
  t.get2();                    // "x"
  t.map1(i -> i * 2);          // (42, "x")
  t.map2(s -> s + "!");        // (21, "x!")
  t.mapAll(Object::toString, String::length);  // ("21", 1)

  var tf = Tuple2.tuple2((Function<Integer, String>) Object::toString,
                         (Function<String, Integer>) String::length);
  t.applyTo(tf);                  // applies both functions component-wise: ("21", 1)

  t.swap();                    // ("x", 21)
  t.toRecord();                // Record2[value1=21, value2=x]
Seit:
1.0.0

    • toPair

      @UnwindingOperation public MutablePair<A1,A2> toPair()

      Converts this tuple to a MutablePair by evaluating both component suppliers.

      Semantics:

      • Evaluation: calls get1() and get2() to obtain the current values.
      • Mutability: the returned MutablePair is a separate, mutable container.
      • Nullability: this tuple holds non-null values by contract; MutablePair can represent nulls, but this method will populate it with non-null values.

      Gibt zurück:
      a MutablePair containing the evaluated values of this tuple
      Seit:
      1.0.0
